scope: Four JSDOM clients, real game scripts and local Firebase emulator; synthetic campaign and archives only. REST full JSON bodies measured by a clone of responses, including responses otherwise cancelled by the app. SDK counters count JSON string characters, not UTF-8/network bytes. Callback bytes count application work and may overlap; do not add them to transport totals. No TLS, HTTP/WebSocket headers, compression, media, Internet latency or Firebase billing measured.
